name: Advena Vita
author: MetalSyntax
description: This is a native PS Vita port of Advena: Legend of Emeris, the classic Action-RPG developed and published by Gamevil, running via an ARM dynamic library loader (soloader) and FalsoJNI.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
